create_agent_subclass: create a subclass of Agent that implements __call__ to produce actions from observations
implement_agent_call: implement the __call__ method to return a triplet of current state, action, and next state
implement_agent_update: implement the update method to update the pytorch model of the agent
override_require_history: override require_history to return True for transformer based policies needing previous transitions
review_agent_interface: review the Agent base class interface for state, input, user_info, and history parameters
